load-idle.desc: Page load: listeners registered, getSettings() theme applied, nothing scheduled while idle.

image-basic.desc: Image drop (avatar, dropId → reactions): appears, spotlight, pop, life bar, leaves at 4 s, removed at 4.4 s, stageEmpty.

caption-fit.desc: Caption font size fitted to the displayed media width (13..40 px), trimming / 80-char truncation.

kids.text: quand le build passe du premier coup

test-drop.desc: Settings "test" drop (media.kind = test, SVG placeholder, no avatar image → initial).

gif-drop.desc: Animated GIF drop with caption; kind "gif" is shown like an image.

music-with-image.desc: Image + music: music plays at musicVolume, is paused when the image leaves; music is ignored for non image/gif media.

rain-only.desc: Emoji rain without media: 38 particles, random but bounded parameters, all removed by 5.3 s; no slot, no stageEmpty.

steps.step: t=3500 (particles left depend on the random timings)

rain-variants.desc: Rain as a single string (legacy), as an empty array, and together with an image drop.

tts-unreachable.desc: TTS only, ttsUrl unreachable → speechSynthesis fallback spoken exactly once; toast 3 s; no slot.

tts-no-url-long.desc: TTS without ttsUrl → speechSynthesis immediately; text sliced (200 spoken / 120 shown); toast 12 s cap.

tts-reachable.desc: TTS with a working ttsUrl: server audio played at volume, no speechSynthesis fallback.

audio-drop.desc: Audio drop (blob WAV): top toast with avatar + caption, plays at musicVolume, no cursor watch; on end → toast leaves, slot released → stageEmpty.

audio-drop-error.desc: Audio drop with unreachable URL: error → toast leaves → released once.

video-ends.desc: Video (WebM declaring 2 s, content ~1.6 s): life bar = duration + 300 ms, caption size, removed when playback ends.

video-no-duration.desc: Video straight from MediaRecorder (no Duration element → duration Infinity at loadedmetadata): lifetime = cap + 300 ms, removed at end.

video-cap-playback.desc: Video longer than videoDuration (8 s file, cap 2 s): stopped by the playback-time check (timeupdate) and removed.

steps.step: metadata loaded (lifetime 2300 ms on the paused clock)
capped by playback time → leaving, paused

video-cap-timer.desc: Video capped by the removal timer (4 s file, cap 2 s → lifetime 2300 ms on the fake clock).

video-unreachable.desc: Video with an unreachable URL: error → smooth close (220 ms) → removed, slot released.

video-stalled.desc: Video whose server never answers: removed by the 15 s load watchdog.

image-bad-url.desc: Image whose URL answers 404: error → smooth close → removed.

rapid-8.desc: 8 drops at once: 6 shown (MAX_CONCURRENT), 2 queued and shown as slots free up; one stageEmpty at the very end.

queue-overflow-20.desc: 20 drops at once: 6 shown, 12 queued (MAX_QUEUE), 2 discarded; 18 anchors in total.

queue-tts-deferred.desc: A queued drop carrying TTS only speaks when it is actually shown (not when queued).

steps.step: slot freed → queued drop shown and spoken

close-button.desc: Close button: click-through while not captured; hover → capture; mousedown on ✕ → smooth close, capture released, stageEmpty.

actions: mousedown on ✕ before the cursor poll: click-through

reaction.desc: Reaction bar: one reactDrop(dropId, emoji) per drop, later clicks ignored; no bar without dropId.

actions: hit-test keeps capture over the bar: ["1"]

steps.step: drop without dropId has no bar

live-settings-visual.desc: Live settings: opacity (clamped 0.2..1) on drops and toasts, theme, spotlight off/on.

steps.step: new drop brings the spotlight back

spotlight-stack.desc: Spotlight follows the newest drop, falls back to the previous one when it leaves, switches off (rAF stopped) when none is left.

steps.step: A removed → spotlight off, nothing scheduled

live-settings-duration.desc: Live "Image duration": images rescheduled from their start time, removed at once when already past.

steps.step: t=3000 duration→1: B already past → leaving now

live-settings-volume.desc: Live volume: "volume" → videos only; "musicVolume" → audio drops + image music; TTS audio untouched; 0 → muted. (The video here never receives data: a playing video re-applies its initial volume on every canplay/play event, which makes a playing video racy — see the bug report.)

video-volume-initial.desc: A playing video gets the "volume" of its drop settings (no live change here).

live-settings-videoDuration.desc: Live "Video max duration": shorter than elapsed → stop now; longer → rescheduled (min(natural, cap)).

steps.step: video 2: cap→3 s at 1 s → 2000 ms left
later updates do not touch a leaving drop

live-videoDuration-increase.desc: Raising "Video max duration" live (2 s → 30 s) while a ~6.6 s video plays: does the video keep playing past 2 s?

steps.step: cap raised to 30 s (timer → min(8 s, 30 s))

stage-empty-with-toast.desc: stageEmpty is sent when the last slot drop leaves, even if a TTS toast / rain is still on screen.

speech.text: un message assez long pour durerun message assez long pour durerun message assez long pour durerun message assez long pour durer

kids.text: 🗣️ un message assez long pour durerun message assez long pour durerun message assez long pour durerun message assez long po

steps.step: t=7980 toast removed (7680 ms + 300), no further stageEmpty

effects.desc: Entry effects: zoom / tornade / glitch classes, shake on <body> for 700 ms, unknown effect ignored.

avoid-zone.desc: avoidZone none/center/top/bottom: drop centres stay in the 14..86 % × 20..80 % box and out of the excluded zone.

drag-flow.desc: Hover detection from cursor IPC (margins), capture, drag (anchor follows the mouse, bob paused), release, exit capture, edge clamp, removal during drag.

actions: ipc 20 px right of the drop (outside 14 px margin): delivered
ipc 45 px below the drop (outside 40 px margin): delivered
ipc 35 px below the drop (inside bottom margin): delivered
ipc 10 px right of the drop: delivered

steps.step: dragged past the top-left edge → clamped to 0 %

hover-overlap.desc: Two overlapping drops: which one gets the hover / is dragged when the cursor is over the newer (top-most) one.

actions: hover drop 2: cursor over drop 2 (ipc delivered)
ipc at the shared centre: delivered

cursor-watch.desc: Cursor IPC only flows while the renderer watches (first visual drop → watchCursor, last removed → unwatchCursor); unchanged positions are not resent.

actions: ipc after a TTS-only drop: not-watching

avatar-variants.desc: Avatar bubble: image, no avatar (initial), broken avatar URL (falls back to initial), empty username (?), no sender (no bubble).

drop-guards.desc: Payloads with nothing to show are ignored (null, {}, empty fields); settings defaults when the payload has none.

duration-bounds.desc: Image duration bounds: 0.5 → 1 s, 100 → 30 s, 0 → 4 s default; initial opacity clamp.

everything-at-once.desc: Image + rain + TTS (no URL) + shake effect + music in a single payload.
